CA.rationale: A processing-origin label (command_estimate/feedback_through) is explicitly linked to the same candidate content assignment.

COD.rationale: For the same referent/time the report gives the content (red positions), an organization/presentation context (current mapping), and an explicit origin/status field.

A.rationale: Processing-origin labels (e.g. command_estimate/feedback_through) are explicitly associated with the same candidate content assignments.

C.rationale: The report lists identified contents (color-labeled sets) tied to named referents and times.

D.rationale: Origin/kind/represented_time metadata separately attribute status/source to contents across referents and times.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are organized/presented (coordinate mappings, grid orientation) for named referents.
